site_coordinates.definition: NASA lists Malapert Massif as an Artemis III candidate region (Release 22-089). Coordinates are IAU Gazetteer Feature 16338, Mons Malapert center solution 1 (planetographic, +East, -180 to 180), not the crater Malapert or the official candidate-region center. DEM frame compatibility with MOON_ME remains pending M2 confirmation.

warnings: PRELIMINARY: coordinates are IAU Gazetteer feature centers, not independently verified Artemis region centers or landing points.
PRELIMINARY: DEM horizon frame is not confirmed compatible with the M2 MOON_ME ephemeris frame.
